source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves like rather than silently and, and repeated plunder plus vine image.
Renders two rare equipment terms cautiously with uncertainty noted; retains color and preparation.
Keeps unnamed commander, stumbling, and uncertain siege screen without fixing attacker/defender identification.
Retains terse water and dissolution imagery without inventing the engineering of Nineveh's fall.
Chooses passive decree rather than proper name Huzzab; preserves female captives and mourning gesture.
Follows difficult since-her-days wording and repeated futile command.
Preserves source her/your shift, lion-to-military linkage, and final silencing of messengers.
